name: indirect_contact_tower_identification
title: Fluid cooler (indirect-contact cooling tower): catalogue identification
summary: Identification of a closed-loop (indirect-contact) cooling tower from B.A.C. VXI catalogue data: equivalent counterflow exchanger between the cooled fluid and a fictitious air at the wet-bulb temperature, air/fluid resistance split with mass-flow exponents, percentage error against the catalogue over 205 operating points.

authors: Felipe Trebilcock (ULiege Thermodynamics Lab, Dec 2002, for Laborelec)
origin.course: Laborelec toolkit 2002 (evaporative equipment), fluid-cooler identification model; duplicate group DG-0070 (TM-0296 simulation variant)

verification.summary: Compared the runnable variant with the EES stored solution (kJ/kW values converted by hand, resistances K/kW /1000): 40 common variables, max relative difference 8.08e-02 on ERQ_dot_ct/ERRQ_dot_ct (the 2.97e-03 deviation of Q_dot_ct amplified on the small error term), all other deviations below 4.2e-03 (EES vs CoolProp humid-air properties). Native file fails only on the HX call (CS-GAP-HX).
verification.reference: EES stored solution of Indirect_contact_identification.EES (ees_variables.csv); catalogue table checked at rows 100 (file's worked example) and 205 (stored point)
verification.notes: Concerns the variant indirect_contact_tower_identification_coolsolve.eescode (regression target CSL-0286:coolsolve). Deviations: Q_dot_ct 2.97e-03, h_a 2.6e-03, c_p_af 4.0e-03, epsilon_ct 1.3e-03; ERQ/ERRQ 8.08e-02 by amplification. Stale variables of an earlier program excluded (C_dot, R, epsilon, V_dot, rho, R_a, w, COP).
